QuestInfo.0: They're back! The terrifyingly corny monster couples. Defeat these kings of lame to obtain some awesome prizes. Go ask \r\n#p9010010# for more details.
QuestInfo.1: They're back! The terrifyingly corny monster couples. Defeat these kings of lame to obtain some awesome prizes.
QuestInfo.2: They're back! The terrifyingly corny monster couples. Defeat these kings of lame to obtain some awesome prizes. Check out the list of areas below to get an idea of what you're up against.

0.1: Somebody stab my eyes out, please.
0.2: It's so gross. The #rCouple Monsters#k are back, and they're all over each other. It makes me throw up in my mouth just thinking about it.
0.3: For the good of the entire world, those #rCouple Monsters#k must be destroyed! AND I'M NOT JUST SAYING THAT BECAUSE I'M SINGLE AND JEALOUS AND SUPER LONELY.

no.0: Ugh, don't tell me you're one of those lamers in a "happy relationship"...

yes.0: Check your Quest Log to see where the Couple Monsters are cozied up. You should also check their levels before you head out there.
yes.1: You'll only get credit for hunting #rCouple Monsters#k near your level, okay? That means monsters that are less than 11 levels below or 21 levels above you.

default.0: HEY, weren't you supposed to defeat some #rCouple Monsters#k for me?
